l.i: ET tu igitur, tandem tumuli sub mole repostus,
Et quam inuidisti vium tibi tute quietem,
Ipsa tibi cura, & sancti peperere labores,
tu funde rosas, funde isti lilia tellus,
Quo nil candidius fuit & nil suauius vnquam,
Et grauis huic vt sis caueas iuuenisve senexve,
CVi niueus toto regnabat pectore candor,
Vnum cui cælum cura, laborque fuit,
Nu rogitas qua sit dictus ratione Melachthon?
Nempe mare Euxinu qua ratione vocat,

page.notes: Printed text is in italic throughout. Doubtful readings: "vium" (likely "vitam"), "Nu rogitas" (likely "Nunc rogitas"), "Melachthon" as printed, "Euxinu" as printed. The line "Nempe mare Euxinu..." is followed by a catchword-like mark "H 2" which is the signature, not text.
